Name: Pond Added To Farm
Author: tikamin557
Description:
All default settings are disabled.

[size=4]If the ground around a pond looks unnatural after placing it in your desired location, you can use[/size]
[size=4]"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54235][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54235](CP) T's Terrain Flooring[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54235][/url]" to help it blend more naturally with the surrounding terrain.[/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Compatibility with custom farm map mods.[/size][/color]
Most custom farm mods that replace vanilla farm maps are compatible by default.
However, custom farm mods that add new farm types or separate farm maps require additional compatibility support.
If you'd like to request compatibility with a custom farm mod that isn't currently supported, please let me know on the POSTS page.

"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28885]Fill The Pond[/url]" allows you to hide individual ponds that are in place by default.
You can also use this mod to place a new pond of any size in the location where you have hidden the pond.


Currently supported in English and Japanese and French.
